records.why: STATE: strict appointment-setting does not itself conduct the Florida home solicitation sale defined in §501.021 because the canvasser does not take a buyer agreement or offer to purchase or consummate a sale at the door; §501.022 applies to conducting that defined sale. LOCAL: the final controlled audit for Apollo Beach under the legal-jurisdiction/address rule shown for this row does not carry a current route-specific canvasser permit/registration requirement for this appointment-setting activity. See the detailed legal/source record for the jurisdiction-specific local basis and any §163.211 analysis. THIS RATIONALE APPLIES ONLY WHILE THE CANVASSER REMAINS APPOINTMENT-ONLY. If activity becomes an order, agreement, bid/price negotiation, contract, deposit/collection, financing transaction, or other sale activity, stop and use the applicable HSS/contractor controls.
records.script: We are Paradise Exteriors. We are only setting a future appointment. We are not taking an order, signing a contract, collecting money, giving a bid, or completing a sale at the door. Our compliance review for Apollo Beach does not require a separate route-specific canvasser permit for this appointment-setting activity. We will follow all posted-property, refusal, access, and local operating rules. If you believe a permit applies, I will stop and have our manager verify it.
records.challenge: Resident / HOA / security: identify Paradise, use the approved explanation once, honor any refusal or private-property direction, and leave if asked. Government or law enforcement: do not argue or debate the law; stop if directed, record the person's name, agency, location, time, and what was requested, and contact manager/compliance before resuming.
records.hangerPlacement: Preferred unattended method: place the approved die-cut/slit hanger over the lawful front-door knob/handle so it is secure against wind. No tape, staples, nails, glue, adhesive, mailbox contact, damage, or obstruction of the lock/latch/door operation. Honor all signs/refusals and the full row; use only the municipality-compliant material version.

records.hangerHandoff: Direct handoff to a willing resident is allowed.
records.hangerSigns: Do not leave at private property posted with a reasonably conspicuous No Advertising or No Solicitation sign; honor direct refusal and No Trespassing/access controls.
records.hangerSecurement: Use secure Paradise-standard private-entry placement; do not create litter.
records.hangerMailbox: NEVER use, insert into, attach to, hang from, or support on a USPS mail receptacle.
records.hangerPublic: This county handbill division governs private property in unincorporated Hillsborough; do not use public ROW as a distribution surface.

records.courtesyPlacement: Preferred unattended method: place the approved die-cut/slit hanger over the lawful front-door knob/handle so it is secure against wind. records.courtesyContent: INSTALLATION-DAY COURTESY ONLY — NO SALES CTA. No free estimate, free inspection, discount, financing, quote/schedule request, sales QR/URL, product/service pitch, referral offer, neighbor pricing, testimonial, or cross-sell. Operational contact only. Always list both Paradise entities; no installer checkbox or entity selection.

Operations phone only; no sales QR/URL.
